meta.title: Landscape Management and Lawn Care in Grand Rapids | CAMP
meta.description: Mowing, edging, bed maintenance, mulch, fertilizer and weed control in Grand Rapids for apartment communities, offices, HOAs and homes. CAMP Landscape.

hero.kicker: Landscape management and lawn care in Grand Rapids
hero.title: Week after week, **no chasing.**
hero.lede: CAMP keeps lawns cut, edges sharp and beds kept for apartment communities, offices, HOAs and homes across greater Grand Rapids, on a schedule you never have to follow up on.

blocks.title: The first thing people see **is the lawn.**
body: When residents, tenants or customers pull in, the grounds are the first impression. Long grass, weeds in the beds or a ragged edge along the walk say the property is slipping, even when everything inside is fine.

Landscape management is the steady work that keeps that from happening: mowing and edging on a set schedule, beds pruned and weeded, fresh mulch and a lawn program that keeps the turf thick. You stop scrambling for last-minute fixes and stop worrying about curb appeal.
checks: A consistent mowing schedule with sharp edges on walks, curbs and beds
Seasonal pruning, perennial cutbacks and weed control in the beds
Fresh mulch that holds moisture and keeps weeds down
Fertilizer and weed control, timed to work

blocks.title: Same property. **Every season.**
blocks.intro: What a year of landscape management looks like on one site. It opens on the season we are in now.

blocks.title: Everything the grounds need, **on one plan.**
blocks.intro: Take the whole list or the parts your property needs. Each is priced and scheduled up front.

items.title: Lawn mowing and edging
items.body: A clean, even mow on a consistent schedule, with precise edges along walkways, curbs and beds and the clippings blown off the hard surfaces.

items.title: Bed maintenance
items.body: Seasonal pruning, perennial cutbacks, weed control and attention to soil health.

items.title: Mulch
items.body: A fresh layer of quality mulch regulates soil temperature, holds moisture and blocks weeds, and gives the beds a finished look.

items.title: Fertilizer and weed control
items.body: Routine fertilization and weed control keep turf green, thick and ready for visitors, applied with care and timed to work.

items.title: Personal groundskeeper
items.body: For properties that need a closer eye: hand pruning, selective weeding and site-specific care. You choose how often, we handle the rest.

items.title: Cleanups
items.body: Beds cleared and cut back in spring, leaves gone and the property reset in fall, so the year starts and ends clean.

blocks.title: Bring an overgrown bed **back.**
blocks.intro: Drag across the picture. This is what one bed maintenance visit does to an entry that has been mowed around for a season.

blocks.title: A partner who shows up, **so you do not have to check.**
body: You manage a lot more than the grass. You should not have to chase a crew, walk the site after every visit or field complaints about the lawn. We keep the grounds on track and tell you when something needs a decision.

One company can carry the property all year: mowing and beds in season, [irrigation](/irrigation/) start up and winterization, and [snow and ice removal](/snow-and-ice-removal/) when it turns. One contact, one schedule.
checks: Apartment communities, offices, retail and HOAs
A set schedule, written down before the season starts
One contact for the grounds, the sprinklers and the snow

blocks.title: Clear the leaves **before the snow.**
blocks.intro: A real CAMP cleanup. Leaves left over winter smother the grass and the beds; a fall cleanup sends the property into winter clean.

faq.a: Lawn mowing and edging on a set schedule, bed maintenance with seasonal pruning, perennial cutbacks and weed control, mulch, lawn fertilizer and weed control, and spring and fall cleanups. A personal groundskeeper option adds hand pruning and site-specific care at the frequency you choose.

faq.q: Do you work for apartment communities and HOAs?
faq.a: Yes. Much of our landscape management is for property managers of apartment communities, offices and HOAs. See [commercial grounds care](/commercial/).

faq.q: Do you maintain residential yards too?
faq.a: Yes. Homes get the same mowing, edging, bed care and lawn program as the commercial sites we look after.
On a consistent schedule set for your property before the season starts. Most lawns are cut weekly in the growing season, and we agree on the frequency on the walk.

faq.q: Can the same company handle irrigation and snow removal?
faq.a: Yes. Sprinkler start up, service and winterization and commercial snow and ice removal can be scheduled with landscape management, so one company looks after the property all year.
Tree removals, trimming and stump grinding are done by our sister company, [Ole Man RB's Tree Service](https://olemanrb.com/), so one call still covers it.

faq.q: How much does landscape management cost?
faq.a: It depends on the size of the property, how often it is mowed and what the season includes. We price it after walking the site. Call or text [(616) 308-4862](tel:+16163084862) to set that up.

quote.title: Hand us the grounds.
quote.lede: Tell us about the property and what you want handled. We will walk it with you and come back with a schedule and an estimate for the season.
